answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 77 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a vault bet on surviving 77 epochs of grading, and every zenith settlement recomputes the ivory schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
